=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_guard_differential.py: lines 980-985 (test_ci_check_runs_before_any_pr_code, the `assert not re.search(r"(?:^|\s)(?:-r|-e|-c|\.{0,2}/|tests/|scripts/|\.claude/)", ...)` line) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The install-step check allows bare local installs, long-form pip flags, URL installs, and arbitrary shell appended after the pip command.
  WHY: These shapes can execute PR-controlled code before the verifier and plant a `.pth` file that controls its exit code.
- Requirement: "The new test `test_ci_check_runs_before_any_pr_code` fails when anything other than `actions/checkout`, `actions/setup-python` (only `python-version`), and the fixed package-name `pip install` runs before it." (PR description, "Findings fixed" table row 1, "Verified by" column.)
  Expected change site: tests/test_guard_differential.py::test_ci_check_runs_before_any_pr_code (the install-content assertion around lines 980-985).
  Evidence of absence: The assertion only forbids `-r|-e|-c`, `./`/`../` paths, and the literal path prefixes `tests/`, `scripts/`, `.claude/`. It does not (a) block bare `pip install .` or `pip install .[extras]`, (b) block long-form flags `--requirement`/`--editable`/`--constraint`, (c) block VCS / direct-URL installs (`git+https://…`, `https://…`, `http://…`), or (d) restrict the step to the literal fixed package set. It also does not prevent additional shell being appended after the `python3 -m pip install` line. With these gaps, the test does not fail when "anything other than … the fixed package-name `pip install`" runs before the check, so the stated verification contract is unmet. The same root cause is the SECURITY finding above.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
